articles.summary: NioCorp is pleased to announce that Executive Chairman and CEO Mark A. Smith will participate in Maxim Group’s virtual "Mining The Industrial Supply Chain" conference on Tuesday, April 21, 2026.
articles.title: NioCorp to Participate in Maxim Group’s “Mining the Industrial Supply Chain” Conference on Apr. 21

articles.summary: NioCorp today announced that it has entered into a non-binding agreement with Traxys North America outlining a long-term marketing and offtake arrangement for NioCorp’s remaining planned critical minerals products from its Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project.
articles.title: NioCorp Reaches Non-Binding Agreement with Traxys North America for Potential Purchase of All of NioCorp’s Remaining Planned Products

articles.summary: NioCorp today announced that the State of Nebraska has enacted legislation designed to give NioCorp greater flexibility in qualifying for approximately $200 million over 10 years in state tax benefits.
articles.title: Nebraska Passes Law Giving NioCorp More Flexibility in Achieving State Tax Incentives

articles.summary: NioCorp today announced voting result details from the election of directors at its 2025 Annual General Meeting, held on April 6, 2026 in Denver, CO.
articles.title: NioCorp Reports Voting Results from its 2025 Annual General Meeting
